g.text: CampusClaw Target Session Events Resource Model
check prerequisites and determine Session order
short transaction: recheck, allocate sequence, append
[zero or more internal executions while the live stream stays open]
append through the same Session ordering boundary
short transaction: recheck, allocate sequence, append
Recover from POST uncertainty, SSE gap, or reconnect
read committed snapshot in internal sequence order
Multiple callers may subscribe to the same Session.
Each connection owns a bounded queue and fails independently.
The Hub performs no replay and is never the recovery authority.
No executionId or runId crosses the HTTP boundary.
The accepted event is durable before success is returned.
Disconnect never cancels execution or retries the POST.
Dependent events cannot precede uncommitted prerequisites.
Independent events use Session acceptance order.
Model calls, tool calls, and prerequisite waits stay outside DB transactions.
The first history page captures its watermark and filters.
Every later opaque page remains bound to that snapshot.
The client keeps response array order, never timestamp order.
Public events use eventId; entrySeq remains internal.
